defects.symptom: Hit and rebound use the correct runtime action/phase, but the whole character/stool registration visibly shifts between frames. Head/torso/legs/stool move far beyond the active left-arm motion, producing a teleport-like transition.
evidence: runtime-qa.json reports correct actionKey/phase/frame and no runtime errors
defects.fixDecision: Do not change runtime mapping first. Compare both formal frames to approved neutral and quantify locked-region displacement; repair only if image-level delta is the root cause. Respect active SN:L formal-image CLAIMs before any PNG edit.

sourceAuthority.shaPolicy: Resolve and record exact SHA256 for all three from latest main before any edit.
sourceAuthority.motionAuthority: SN:L means left arm/stick is the active upper-limb motion; fixed snare contact and current limb sidecar remain authoritative.

preserveExactly: head position and head silhouette except pixels unavoidably occluded by allowed left-arm edit
drum stool position, scale, angle and legs
all pixels outside the explicitly computed left-arm/left-hand/left-stick ROI whenever technically possible
allowedChanges: small local clothing/hair occlusion pixels only where the moved left arm physically crosses them

targetState.hit: Left stick reaches the authoritative SN contact while the locked body/stool registration remains aligned to neutral.
targetState.rebound: Left stick/forearm moves naturally away from SN hit contact; shoulder/body/stool stay registered to neutral. Rebound must not be a different whole-body drawing.
targetState.transition: neutral -> hit -> rebound -> neutral must read as one seated character moving mainly the left arm, with no whole-body teleport.
numericRequirements: Use current runtime_pose SN:L constraints as numeric authority when available.
Before editing, measure baseline-to-hit and hit-to-rebound displacement for locked regions and record thresholds from actual neutral geometry.
Contact error at hit must satisfy current INSTRUMENT_CONTACT_POINTS/runtime_pose tolerance.

editProcedure: Fetch latest main and verify no active conflicting CLAIM on SN:L formal paths.
Resolve exact SHA256 for neutral/hit/rebound and record them in this repairSpec.
Compute/inspect locked-region differences against neutral; confirm whether the visible jump is image-level rather than runtime mapping.
Define a left-arm/hand/stick ROI and an explicit forbidden mask for head/torso/right arm/legs/stool.
Create a candidate only; do not overwrite formal PNGs.
Bring hit/rebound static regions back to neutral registration while preserving only the action-required left-arm/stick geometry.
Composite candidate with fixed drum and verify SN contact for hit plus natural separation for rebound.
Run hit/rebound/neutral screenshot QA at the same M143 event.
Promote only if all validation checks pass and no regression is visible.

hardPass: inactive right arm/legs/body do not jump
SN hit contact is visibly and numerically valid
rebound visibly moves away from hit rather than holding contact
validation.pixelRule: Target outside-ROI changed pixels = 0 where the chosen edit method can enforce it; any non-zero value must be explicitly explained and reviewed.

forbidden: changing runtime mapping when mapping is already proven correct
changing right arm/legs/stool to make the new frame look aesthetically balanced

rollback.rule: If target defect is not improved or any new regression appears, restore/reconcile against the protected baseline before further attempts.

decisionLog: Runtime QA already reports correct actionKey/phase/frame and no runtime errors, so mapping change is not the first repair.
Visual evidence shows motion outside the active left arm, so repair must first quantify and eliminate locked-region displacement.

defects.symptom: Hit and rebound are both selected correctly, but the character changes whole-body pose/camera registration between phases. The torso, head, legs, stool relationship and overall silhouette jump rather than showing a localized rebound.
evidence: runtime-qa.json reports correct actionKey/phase/frame and no runtime errors
defects.fixDecision: Treat as visual asset-continuity defect unless locked-region diff proves otherwise. Preserve fixed drum/runtime mapping; compare hit/rebound against neutral and choose the smallest image-level repair or frame-hold strategy that removes whole-body teleport.

hardPass: correct right hand/right foot remain active

decisionLog: Runtime selection is reported correct, so current evidence points first to asset continuity/registration.
Because this is a simultaneous hand+foot action, repair must preserve both action semantics and cannot be reduced to arm-only editing without checking BD foot motion.

repairSpecSchema.purpose: Every defect must carry a reproducible, machine-readable repair recipe before any fix begins. The recipe must tell a later AI/terminal exactly what source to use, what is locked, what may move, the target geometry/behavior, validation thresholds, rollback point, and forbidden strategies.

fieldRules.sourceAuthority: Must identify exact formal path(s) and SHA256 before image work; GitHub main is authority.
fieldRules.preserveExactly: Enumerate body/camera/stool/static regions that must not move or change. Never say only 'keep same'.
fieldRules.allowedChanges: Enumerate only regions/values allowed to change for this defect.
fieldRules.targetState: Describe the desired visible result and, where available, numeric contact/joint/timing targets.
fieldRules.editProcedure: Ordered steps, one operation per step, including candidate path and comparison baseline.
fieldRules.validation: Explicit PASS/FAIL checks with measurable thresholds where possible.
fieldRules.forbidden: Known bad strategies and unrelated changes prohibited for this issue.
fieldRules.rollback: Exact backup branch/commit and issue-local restore rule.
fieldRules.decisionLog: Why this repair was chosen over alternatives; update whenever evidence changes.
